name: Sudokuvania: Digits of Despair
storyline: Every 100 years, the mysterious castle of Sudokuvania appears in the countryside. Legend has it that it contains the Secret of Sudoku. Gathering the last few given digits in the area, you solemnly approach the boxy fortress, determined to discover the secret and share it with your favorite people.
summary: Sudokuvania is a puzzle hunt combining sudoku with Metroidvanias. As you clear the 40x50 map of dynamic fog, you will uncover new clues and new rules. Some cells' contents can only be found by solving linked Boss Puzzles. There is even a bit of a story. All in all, Sudokuvania is over 20 puzzles in one!
